digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler differ and mutation emit
propositions: The raw differ API correctly emits field_drift when given real local state versus remote Jira state, serving as a positive control for contract compliance.

A4-1 already filters differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local emissions at the production call-site, and this filter must remain to enable future migration to real local state without weakening the pure differ.
The A4-1 call-site filter does not suppress genuine mutations (inbound creates, seed repairs) or break convergence behavior.
No source, test, or documentation changes are required because A4-1 already contains the production filter and load-bearing tests.
The no-change decision for _compute_mutations_emit_both preserves the raw-differ positive control and honors the production call-site's exceptional use of remote state for both arguments.
